To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
oxygen-incorporated cobalt sulfide nanocubes are a promising non-noble metal catalyst for electrochemical water oxidation in alkaline/ neutral media.

the oxygen-containing amorphous cobaltsulfide porous nanocube (A-CoS(4.6)O(0.6)PNC) electrocatalysts exhibit superior electrocatalytic activities for oxygen evolution reaction (OER) in alkaline/ neutral medium.
oxygen-incorporated cobalt sulfide nanocubes show advantages over the RuO2 catalyst for the oxygen evolution reaction in alkaline/ neutral medium.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel OER electro catalyst, which can be used as an alternative to the benchmark RuO 2 catalyst in both alkaline and neutral medium.
the synthesis and characterization of oxygen-containing amorphous cobolt sulfide porous nancubes as high-activity electrocatalysts for the oxygen evolution reaction in an alkaline/neutral solution.
the design and synthesis of a new OER electrocategorist.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the oxygen doping in amorphous cobalts sulfide porous nanospheres (A-CoSx) is an effective strategy to enhance the OER activity.
oxygen doping and amorphous structure are both crucial for the excellent OER activity of amorphous CoS-based electrocatalysts.
the oxygen-containing amorphous CoS4.5 O0.5 porous nanocubes with the distorted Co-S-O octahedron and the oxygen doping are the key factors for the excellent OER activity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the OER activity of amorphous cobaltsulfides could be significantly improved by introducing oxygen into their crystal structures.
the oxygen-containing amorphous cobaltsulfide porous nanocube (A-CoSxOyPNC) electrocatalyst is a promising alternative to the noble-metal based OER catalyst in alkaline and neutral media.
the O* adsorption strength can be tuned by adjusting the Co-S-O bonding strength, and the OER performance can be improved through the synergistic effect of oxygen doping.
The main takeaway from our work is that
OER catalysts with a low overpotential and high current density can be obtained by the synergistic effect of the structure distortion and oxygen doping.

oxygen-containing amorphous CoSx porous nanocubes can be a promising OER electrocategorist in alkaline/acidic media, and the rational design of oxygen-containing amorphouos metal sulfides may open a new way for developing highly active OER catalysts.
the OER activity of the cobalt-based materials can be significantly enhanced by the incorporation of oxygen into the amorphous CoS4.
